'Building It Ourselves': Morgan Stanley Created an AI Tool to Fix the Most Annoying Part of Coding. Here's How It Works.
Morgan Stanley first introduced the AI tool in January, and it has since saved developers 280,000 hours of work.
By
Sherin Shibu
Edited by
Melissa Malamut
Jun 3, 2025
Share
Copy
Key Takeaways
Morgan Stanley’s new AI tool translates code in older languages into plain English.
The bank’s developers can then use the English specs to rewrite the code into a newer language.
The tool has helped Morgan Stanley's 15,000 developers save time.
Morgan Stanley built its in-house AI tool to tackle a difficult
coding
problem: reworking old legacy code into more updated
coding
languages.
Morgan Stanley introduced the AI tool, which is based on OpenAI's GPT models, in January, per
The Wall Street Journal
. The tool, called DevGen.AI, translates code in older languages, such as Perl (released in
1987
), into plain English, which developers can then use as a basis for rewriting the code into newer languages like Python.
Related:
Amazon Cloud CEO Predicts a Future Where Most Software Engineers Don't Code — and AI Does It Instead
Mike Pizzi, Morgan Stanley's global head of technology and operations, told
WSJ
that in the five months since its launch, DevGen.AI has worked through nine million lines of code, saving the firm's 15,000 developers roughly 280,000 hours of work.
Pizzi said that Morgan Stanley opted to build the tool itself because tech companies didn't have any solutions that could fit Morgan Stanley's exact specifications. Commercial tools lacked expertise in deciphering older coding languages, especially those specific to a company.
"We found that building it ourselves gave us certain capabilities that we're not really seeing in some of the commercial products," Pizzi told
WSJ
. "We saw the opportunity to get the jump early."
Related:
Morgan Stanley Plans to Lay Off 2,000 Workers, Replacing Some with AI
Morgan Stanley trained DevGen.AI on languages within its own code base, including languages customized for the company. However, the AI tool still has growing to do when it comes to full translation. Though the tool can, in theory, rewrite code from an older language to a newer one, it doesn't know how to write the new code efficiently or as well as a human developer, Pizzi said.
That's why Morgan Stanley is keeping human developers involved in the process of translating old or legacy code to new languages. Pizzi disclosed that the firm will not be reducing its software engineering workforce as a result of the AI tool, though the company did lay off 2,000 of its
80,000-person
workforce in March.
Morgan Stanley has released several
AI apps
for employees, including one that helps them summarize video meetings and another that quickly finds information for them from the company's body of research.
Morgan Stanley CEO Ted Pick told investors last year that the AI tools could save employees up to 15 hours per week and be "potentially really game-changing," per
Reuters
.

data.author: gregorywegory
data.article_summary:
**cloudflare/workers-oauth-provider** 是一个用于 Cloudflare Workers 的 OAuth 2.1 提供者库，用 TypeScript 编写，支持 PKCE。该库作为 Worker 代码的包装器，自动处理令牌管理，并为 API 端点添加授权功能。其主要特点包括：

1. 自动管理所有令牌。
2. API 处理程序接收已认证的用户信息，无需自行验证。
3. 不限定用户管理和认证方式。
4. 不限定 UI 框架，可自由实现授权流程。
5. 存储不包含任何秘密信息，仅存储哈希值。

使用示例中，需配置 API 路由、处理程序、默认处理程序以及授权和令牌交换端点等。该库仍处于测试阶段，API 可能会变化。

- AI工具在生成代码时的表现和局限性是讨论的核心，特别是在复杂问题、上下文保持和安全性方面。

OAuth 2.1 Provider Framework for Cloudflare Workers
This is a TypeScript library that implements the provider side of the OAuth 2.1 protocol with PKCE support. The library is intended to be used on Cloudflare Workers.
Beta
As of March, 2025, this library is very new, prerelease software. The API is still subject to change.
Benefits of this library
The library acts as a wrapper around your Worker code, which adds authorization for your API endpoints.
All token management is handled automatically.
Your API handler is written like a regular fetch handler, but receives the already-authenticated user details as a parameter. No need to perform any checks of your own.
The library is agnostic to how you manage and authenticate users.
The library is agnostic to how you build your UI. Your authorization flow can be implemented using whatever UI framework you use for everything else.
The library's storage does not store any secrets, only hashes of them.

补充讨论：
- AI工具在生成代码时的表现和局限性是讨论的核心，特别是在复杂问题、上下文保持和安全性方面。
- 版权问题和AI生成代码的法律归属也是用户关注的重点之一。
- 手动审查和修改AI生成代码的必要性被多次提及，强调了人类工程师在AI辅助编码中的重要作用。

The iPhone 15 Pro's Depth Maps
Since 2017, Apple have supported depth maps in the images its iPhones capture either via LiDAR scanners, 3D
time-of-flight
scanner-less LIDAR or
structured-light
3D scanning.
These depth maps, along with other imagery, are stored in High Efficiency Image File Format (HEIF) container files. These files can contain multiple images and vast amounts of metadata. This format was originally designed between 2013 and 2015 and Apple adopted its HEIC variant in 2017.
Since then, HEIC files are the default storage container format for images captured on the iPhone. But with that said, it is possible to use the JPEG format instead if things like depth maps and HDR are not of interest.
Finn Jaeger, who is the head of VFX at Replayboys, a film production firm in Hamburg, Germany,
posted
a screenshot a few weeks ago showing how multiple depth maps were being produced by his iPhone.
He announced he was working on a project called
HEIC Shenanigans
. This project contains scripts to separate out images and their metadata from HEIC containers as well as convert them into EXR Files. As of this writing, the project contains 374 lines of Python.
In this post, I'll walk through Finn's codebase with an example image from an iPhone 15 Pro.
My Workstation
I'm using a 5.7 GHz AMD Ryzen 9 9950X CPU. It has 16 cores and 32 threads and 1.2 MB of L1, 16 MB of L2 and 64 MB of L3 cache. It has a liquid cooler attached and is housed in a spacious, full-sized Cooler Master HAF 700 computer case.
The system has 96 GB of DDR5 RAM clocked at 4,800 MT/s and a 5th-generation, Crucial T700 4 TB NVMe M.2 SSD which can read at speeds up to 12,400 MB/s. There is a heatsink on the SSD to help keep its temperature down. This is my system's C drive.
The system is powered by a 1,200-watt, fully modular Corsair Power Supply and is sat on an ASRock X870E Nova 90 Motherboard.
I'm running Ubuntu 24 LTS via Microsoft's Ubuntu for Windows on Windows 11 Pro. In case you're wondering why I don't run a Linux-based desktop as my primary work environment, I'm still using an Nvidia GTX 1080 GPU which has better driver support on Windows and ArcGIS Pro only supports Windows natively.
Installing Prerequisites
I'll use Python 3.12.3 and a few other tools in this post.

libimage-exiftool-perl

exiftool
version 12.76+dfsg-1 which was released at the end of January 2024. Since then, there have been at least ten releases that have addressed issues or enhanced exiftool's HEIC support.
The above version should work fine for the steps in this post but be mindful that any issues you encounter going forward might be resolved with a more up to date version of exiftool.

(jc) to convert the output of various CLI tools into JSON.

I'll use

An iPhone 15 Pro Image
Joel Joseph
, a subject matter expert on the ArcGIS Desktop Products Suite in Mumbai, India, was kind enough to send me an HEIC-contained image he took on his iPhone 15 Pro. I'll use this image in this post. Below is a screenshot.
Extracting the Gain Map
The HEIC file Joel provided is 1.57 MB.

~/heic-shenanigans/gain_map_extract.py

data.title: Autonomous drone defeats human champions in racing first
data.author: picture
data.article_summary: 2025年4月，荷兰代尔夫特理工大学（TU Delft）的科学家和学生团队在阿布扎比举行的A2RL无人机锦标赛中获得冠军。他们的全自主无人机在比赛中击败了13架其他自主无人机和多名人类无人机竞速冠军，创造了人工智能发展的新里程碑。该无人机仅依靠一个前置摄像头，通过深度神经网络进行高性能控制，最终在曲折赛道上达到了95.8公里/小时的速度。与以往在虚拟环境中击败人类冠军的突破不同，这次胜利发生在现实世界中，展示了人工智能在极端时间压力和有限资源下的潜力。这项技术将对自动驾驶汽车和人形机器人等机器人应用产生重要影响。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕无人机竞赛中的自主无人机技术及其潜在应用和影响的讨论。

不同观点：
• **技术进步的积极面**：一些评论者（如[bri3d], [sveinatle]）关注技术本身的进步和创新，讨论无人机在竞赛中的技术细节，如使用Betaflight飞行控制器和Jetson Orin NX，以及自主飞行在高速竞赛中的实现。他们认为这种技术进步非常有趣，并且可能在非竞赛场景中有实际应用，比如搜救任务。

• **技术的潜在军事应用和伦理问题**：部分评论者（如[jandrese], [atonse], [zellyn]）担心这种技术可能被用作武器，尤其是自主无人机在军事或恐怖活动中的潜在应用。他们提到了“Slaughterbots”视频，并表达了对技术被不良行为者利用的担忧。这种观点强调了对技术发展的伦理和安全考量。

• **对技术实现细节的质疑**：一些评论者（如[leeoniya], [snewman], [Quitschquat]）对无人机在具体竞赛场景中的实现提出问题，例如是否针对特定赛道进行了过度拟合，或者人类飞行员与AI相比的劣势。他们还讨论了IMU数据对人类飞行员是否公平，以及神经网络是否在无人机上运行等问题。

• **对技术未来应用的展望和讽刺**：部分评论（如[xnx], [polishdude20]）提到这种技术在国防工业中的潜在应用，并对技术发展可能带来的负面影响进行了讽刺性评论。

补充讨论：
• 一些评论者对具体技术细节表现出浓厚兴趣，例如无人机的硬件配置（如[ilikeatari]）和是否发表了相关研究成果（如[rangestransform]）。
• 还有评论者（如[koolala]）将此技术与Carmack的其他项目进行了对比，认为这是更大的技术突破。

争议焦点：
• 自主无人机技术在竞赛中的公平性及其潜在军事应用是争议的主要焦点。部分评论者对其创新性和实用性表示赞赏，而另一些则担心其被滥用的可能性。

44184900.article_content:
Back to (previous) overview
TU Delft's latest news
Autonomous drone from TU Delft defeats human champions in historic racing first
News
-
15 April 2025
A team of scientists and students from TU Delft has taken first place at the A2RL Drone Championship in Abu Dhabi - an international race that pushes the limits of physical artificial intelligence, challenging teams to fly fully autonomous drones using only a single camera. The TU Delft drone competed against 13 autonomous drones and even human drone racing champions, using innovative methods to train deep neural networks for high-performance control. The gained knowledge on highly-efficient robust AI  will contribute to many robotics applications, from self-driving cars to humanoid robots.
The TU Delft team: Anton Lang, Quentin Missine, Aderik Verraest, Erin Lucassen, Till Blaha, Robin Ferede, Stavrow Bahnam, Christophe De Wagter and Guido de Croon.
Beating human pilots
For the first time, a drone has beaten human pilots in an international drone racing competition, marking a new milestone in the development of artificial intelligence. On Saturday April 14, 2025, two drone racing events took place simultaneously: The Falcon Cup Finals for human pilots and the A2RL Drone Championship for AI-powered, autonomous drones. As a climax, the best AI drones also competed against the best human pilots. The AI drone developed by TU Delft first won the A2RL Grand Challenge. It then went on to win the knockout tournament against human pilots, beating three former DCL world champions and reaching flight speeds up to 95.8 km/h on the very winding track.
The team of scientists and students from TU Delft achieved this by developing an efficient and robust AI system, capable of split-second, high-performance control. Whereas earlier breakthroughs, like AI defeating world champions at chess or Go, have taken place in virtual settings, this achievement happened in the real world. Two years ago, the Robotics and Perception Group at the University of Zürich was the first to beat human drone racing champions with an autonomous drone. However, that impressive achievement occurred in a flight lab environment, where conditions, hardware, and the track were still controlled by the researchers – a very different situation from this world championship, where the hardware and track were fully designed and managed by the competition organisers.
The drone designed by the organizers, A2RL and DCL for use by the AI teams and human pilots.
Pushing the frontiers of physical AI
The goal of the 2025 A2RL Drone Championship in Abu Dhabi was to push the frontier of physical AI, by stimulating research on robotic AI under extreme time pressure and with very limited computational and sensory resources. The drone had access to just one forward-looking camera, a major difference from previous autonomous drone races. This is more similar to how human FPV pilots fly, and leads to additional perception challenges for the AI.
The AI that won against the three former DCL world champions was developed by a team of scientists and students from the MAVLab at TU Delft’s Faculty of Aerospace Engineering. Team lead Christophe De Wagter is both exhausted and exhilarated.
I always wondered when AI would be able to compete with human drone racing pilots in real competitions. I’m extremely proud of the team that we were able to make it happen already this year. I hope that this achievement and this type of competition in general forms a springboard for real-world robot applications.
Christophe De Wagter
Timelapse of the TU Delft drone flying through a gate of the racing track.
AI that directly commands the motors
One of the core new elements of the drone’s AI is the use of a deep neural network that doesn’t send control commands to a traditional human controller, but directly to the motors. These networks were originally developed by the Advanced Concepts Team at the European Space Agency (ESA) under the name of “Guidance and Control Nets”. Traditional, human-engineered algorithms for optimal control were computationally so expensive that they would never be able to run onboard resource-constrained systems such as drones or satellites. ESA found that deep neural networks were able to mimick the outcomes of traditional algorithms, while requiring orders of magnitude less processing time. As it was hard to test whether the networks would perform well on real hardware in space, a collaboration was formed with the MAVLab at TU Delft.
“We now train the deep neural networks with reinforcement learning, a form of learning by trial and error. ”, says Christophe De Wagter. “This allows the drone to more closely approach the physical limits of the system. To get there, though, we had to redesign not only the training procedure for the control, but also how we can learn about the drone’s dynamics from its own onboard sensory data.”

• 自主无人机技术在竞赛中的公平性及其潜在军事应用是争议的主要焦点。部分评论者对其创新性和实用性表示赞赏，而另一些则担心其被滥用的可能性。

data.title: A proposal to restrict sites from accessing a users’ local network
data.author: doener
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个由Chrome安全网络团队提出的提案，旨在限制公共网站未经用户许可访问其本地网络。目前，公共网站可以探测用户的本地网络并可能发动针对脆弱设备的跨站请求伪造（CSRF）攻击。为解决此问题，提案建议废除公共网站直接访问私有IP地址的能力，要求网站在获得用户许可后才能连接其本地网络设备。该方案基于Chrome之前暂停的“私有网络访问（PNA）”工作，但通过权限控制而非预检请求来增强用户控制。其目标是防止驱动式网页对本地设备的利用，同时允许在用户明确许可的情况下进行合法通信。提案不打算破坏现有工作流程，也不解决本地网络HTTPS问题。主要用例包括普通用户和需要通过公共网站控制本地设备的用户（如IoT设备设置）。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：浏览器是否应该允许网站访问用户的本地网络资源，以及如何在安全性和用户体验之间取得平衡。

不同观点：
• mystifyingpoi认为，浏览器默认允许网站访问本地IP是严重的安全隐患，建议通过弹窗提示让用户自行决定是否允许访问，这样可以平衡安全性和灵活性。
• pacifika提到，Internet Explorer以前通过分区系统解决了这一问题，暗示可以借鉴这种做法。
• paxys指出，浏览器默认允许网站访问本地网络服务是安全隐患，尤其在开发环境中容易被忽视，建议加强默认的安全措施。
• sroussey认为，这一改变可能有助于阻止Meta等公司通过本地通信绕过隐私限制。
• skybrian指出，即使需要这种权限的网站，通常也只需要访问一个特定的本地服务器，全面开放本地网络权限违反了最小权限原则。
• ronsor提醒，由于NPAPI插件的移除，一些本地软件依赖于运行在localhost的HTTP服务器，改变这种行为可能会影响这些软件的使用。
• rerdavies担心IPv6环境下，难以区分站点本地的IP地址，这可能导致提案在IPv6网络中出现问题，并提到本地网络地址使用私有证书的必要性。
• AdmiralAsshat提到，像uBlock / uMatrix这样的工具已经默认阻止这种行为，并指出一些知名网站试图探测localhost。
• zajio1am认为，在IPv6过渡期间，使用公共地址的本地网络使得这种解决方案显得不合适。
• nickcw指出，这种改变可能会影响依赖localhost进行OAuth的机制，但认为合理的权限提示可以解决问题。
• phkahler坚决认为，这种访问根本就不应该存在，用户同意只是让问题变得更可以接受，而不是解决它。
• thesdev离题地讨论了标题中的语法问题。
• AshamedCaptain不理解为何要基于IP地址范围扩展保护，认为同源策略应该已经能防止这些问题。
• profmonocle指出，RFC1918地址代表的是私有网络，而非本地网络，建议通过客户端自身的子网掩码来判断IP是否为本地。
• foota提到，虽然替代方案因设备支持问题被暂停，但希望未来可以通过设备选择机制避免权限提示。

补充讨论：
1. 关于IPv6环境下如何判断本地地址的争议，以及私有证书在本地网络中的使用问题。
2. 关于浏览器默认行为和用户教育之间的讨论，如何在不影响用户体验的情况下提升安全性。
3. 对于企业环境中的特殊需求，例如大型企业内部网络的访问需求，如何在方案中进行考虑。

Explainer for Local Network Access
This proposal is an early design sketch by the Chrome Secure Web and Network team to describe the problem below and solicit feedback on the proposed solution. It has not been approved to ship in Chrome.
Proponents
Chrome Secure Web and Network team
Participate
https://github.com/explainers-by-googlers/local-network-access/issues
Introduction
Currently public websites can probe a user's local network, perform CSRF attacks against vulnerable local devices, and generally abuse the user's browser as a "confused deputy" that has access inside the user's local network or software on their local machine. For example, if you visit
evil.com
it can use your browser as a springboard to attack your printer (given an HTTP accessible printer exploit).
Local Network Access aims to prevent these undesired requests to insecure devices on the local network. This is achieved by deprecating direct access to private IP addresses from public websites, and instead requiring that the user grants permission to the initiating website to make connections to their local network.
Note:
This proposal builds on top of Chrome's previously paused
Private Network Access (PNA) work
, but differs by gating access on a permission rather than via preflight requests. This increases the level of user control (at the expense of new permissions that have to be explained to the user) but removes the explicit "device opt-in" that the preflight design achieved. We believe this simpler design will be easier to ship, in order to mitigate the real risks of local network access today. Unlike the previous Private Network Access proposal, which required changes to devices on local networks, this approach should only require changes to sites that need to access the local network. Sites are much easier to update than devices, and so this approach should be much more straightforward to roll out.
Goals
Stop exploitation of vulnerable devices and servers from the drive-by web.
Allow public websites to communicate to private network devices when the user expects it and explicitly allows it.
An adjacent goal is that we want a path for browsers to be good stewards of OS-level local network access permissions. These OS-level permissions are increasingly common (
on iOS, and more recently on macOS
) -- simply because the
browser
has been granted the permission (for legitimate browser functionality the user may want to use, like mirroring the contents of a tab on a local device) should not expose users' local devices to the risks of the open web.
Non-goals
Break existing workflows and services that rely on a public web frontend that can control local network devices.
As long as there is
some
path forward we should be okay with breaking some use cases (e.g., iframe and HTML subresources that aren't explicitly sourced from local hostnames), but overall we want to minimize breakage.
Solve the local network HTTPS problem.
As stated in the
original Private Network Access explainer
:
Provide a secure mechanism for initiating HTTPS connections to services running on the local network or the user's machine. This piece is missing to allow secure public websites to embed non-public resources without running into mixed content violations, with the exception of
http://localhost
which is embeddable. While a useful goal, and maybe even a necessary one in order to deploy Private Network Access more widely, it is out of scope of this specification.
Use cases
Use case 1
The most common case is for users who don't have any services or devices on their local network that expect connections from websites. Today, browsers freely allow JavaScript and subresource requests to these devices without any indication to the end user. Unless this behavior is expected by the user, users should not be exposed to this risk by default.
Use case 2
Public web frontend for controlling or setting up local devices (such as an IoT device, home router, etc.).
Device manufacturers want to be able to give users an easy process for setting up a new device, and one method that is used is to have a page hosted on the manufacturer's public website which then communicates with the device via the user's browser, explicitly relying on the

data.title: Redesigned Swift.org is now live
data.author: lawgimenez
data.article_summary: Swift是一款强大、灵活、多平台的编程语言，具有快速、表达力强和安全的特点。它可以从嵌入式设备和内核扩展到应用程序和云基础设施。Swift编译成原生代码，提供可预测的内存管理，支持面向对象、函数式和泛型编程模式。其设计注重内存安全，消除多种bug和漏洞。Swift与C和C++具有出色的互操作性，允许逐步将现有代码库迁移到Swift。该语言适用于从微控制器到服务器的各种环境，并且是开源的，欢迎贡献和参与。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Swift语言的特性、应用场景、工具支持及其与苹果生态的关联

不同观点：
• ChocolateGod认为Swift是一个各方面表现均衡的语言，具备速度快、内存安全、面向对象和易于编写的特点，但受限于与苹果的关联，且缺乏对Qt等库的绑定支持。
• Kon-Peki避开了对Swift语言本身的讨论，专注于网站设计，表达了对颜色和布局的喜爱。
• Fidotron关注Swift在嵌入式领域的实验性支持，期待WWDC上可能的相关发布，并提到对Go语言标准库中HTTP服务器能力的赞赏。
• Ashvardanian对Swift宣称从嵌入式设备到云基础设施的扩展能力表示怀疑，认为多数人不会认同这一点。
• Pedalpete讨论了Swift在Windows和Android应用开发中的现状，并对团队因人员流失而对选择Swift开发移动应用产生疑虑。
• 90s_dev比较了Swift网站与Go和TypeScript网站的复杂性，并提到Lua网站的简洁性，同时对Swift与C++的互操作文档的复杂性表示担忧。
• AndriyKunitsyn希望Swift团队能更多关注Swift Package Manager的改进。
• Solarkraft希望Swift不仅限于苹果平台，表达了对低层开发能力的兴趣。
• SwiftyBug希望Swift能有更好的开发工具支持，特别是非Xcode的LSP和代码格式化工具。
• Pier25质疑Swift在Web后端应用中的性能，特别是与Vapor框架相关。
• 01HNNWZ0MV43FF幽默地指出Swift在示例代码呈现上比Rust更高效。
• ChrisArchitect提供了Swift网站重新设计的官方链接。
• Mdhb对苹果对开发者的态度表示不满，从而对Swift产生抵触情绪。

补充讨论：
• Swift在嵌入式和非苹果平台上的应用前景是讨论的焦点之一，部分开发者对其跨平台能力和工具支持表示关注和疑虑。
• 对Swift语言特性和性能的认可与对其在特定领域（如Web后端和嵌入式开发）应用中的实际表现存在争议。
• 开发者对Swift工具链（如Swift Package Manager）和开发环境（如Xcode）的改进需求较为强烈。
• 部分讨论偏离主题，如对网站设计的评价和对文档复杂性的抱怨，但总体上仍围绕Swift的应用和支持展开。

data.title: Apple Notes Expected to Gain Markdown Support in iOS 26
data.author: danso
data.article_summary: 据传闻，Apple的Notes应用将在iOS 26和macOS 26中加入Markdown支持（来源：9to5Mac）。这一功能将允许用户使用简单语法进行文本格式化，而无需依赖现有的富文本控件。对习惯键盘操作的用户而言，这将是一个重大升级，可以直接输入**加粗**或#标题等标记符号。此举将使Apple Notes与Obsidian、Notion和Bear等支持Markdown的笔记应用看齐，并方便那些在GitHub或Reddit上熟悉Markdown的用户，无需切换应用。该功能可能会在下周的全球开发者大会上与iOS 26的其他改进一同发布。

主要讨论点：iOS Notes应用的Markdown支持及其相关功能争议

不同观点：
• [lurk2] 不推荐在iOS Notes生态中投资，因为无法在不使用iCloud的情况下导出包含元数据和媒体的笔记。他建议使用Joplin，因为它支持Markdown、多平台客户端以及自托管同步。

44183923.article_content:
Apple Notes Expected to Gain Markdown Support in iOS 26
Wednesday June 4, 2025 4:37 am PDT
by
Tim Hardwick
Apple's Notes app is rumored to be getting Markdown support in iOS 26 and macOS 26, according to
9to5Mac
. The feature would allow users to format text using simple syntax rather than relying on the app's current rich text controls.
Markdown support would be a major upgrade for power users who prefer keyboard-driven formatting. Instead of tapping buttons to bold text or create headers, users could type **bold** or # Header directly into their notes.
The addition would put Apple Notes on par with popular note-taking apps like Obsidian, Notion, and Bear, which have long supported the lightweight markup language. For developers and writers already familiar with Markdown from platforms like GitHub or Reddit, it would also eliminate the need to switch between apps.
If the rumor holds up, it's likely to be unveiled at next week's Worldwide Developers Conference alongside other iOS 26 improvements, including
automatic translation and polls in Messages
, not to mention a
major visual redesign
.

,

data.title: Show HN: Cloudflare Workers Compatible MCP Boilerplate with OAuth & PostgreSQL
data.author: fka
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个用于构建远程模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器的Cloudflare Workers样板项目，包含自定义OAuth认证和PostgreSQL数据库集成。该项目提供了完整的OAuth 2.1提供程序、PostgreSQL数据库集成、Cloudflare Workers无服务器部署、MCP工具框架、自定义REST API路由框架、响应式UI以及安全功能（如JWT tokens和bcrypt hashing）。它还包括一些预定义的MCP工具和可定制的OAuth同意屏幕，支持暗/亮模式切换、自定义品牌和实时更新。开发者可以使用TypeScript和热重载功能，快速添加自定义API端点和工具。项目的主要配置文件为`src/index.ts`。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：自定义OAuth实现及其在生产环境中的适用性，MCP服务器作为OAuth提供者的合理性，以及使用Cloudflare Workers的潜在延迟问题。

不同观点：
• **haxton**：强烈反对将该自定义OAuth实现用于生产环境。他指出了多个安全问题，包括允许空的CSRF状态、将Bearer tokens放在查询字符串中、未检查token是否过期、明文存储秘密信息且未加盐、缺少PKCE验证、调试模式始终开启，以及重定向URL的检查不充分（例如，127.0.0.1.evil.com可以通过检查）。他恳请不要在生产中推荐这种实现。

• **leblancfg**：不赞成MCP服务器作为自己的OAuth提供者。他认为MCP服务器不应该处理OAuth用户管理，只需要存储OAuth tokens。他提到即将发布的草案规范将改变这种情况，MCP服务器将成为OAuth2保护的资源，而不是自己处理认证。他主张将MCP服务器视为URL，而不是独立的基础设施，并希望第三方服务直接暴露MCP端点。

• **written-beyond**：简短评论，认为更值得展示的是GitHub用户名，暗示对项目本身的价值持怀疑态度。

• **swyx**：赞赏该项目的工作，并提出关于使用Cloudflare Workers时调用中央数据库的延迟问题，关注实现中的性能考虑。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：自定义OAuth实现的安全性和适用性。haxton提出了多个严重的安全问题，而leblancfg则从架构角度讨论了MCP服务器不应负责OAuth用户管理。
• **未来方向**：leblancfg提到的新规范草案，建议MCP服务器作为OAuth2保护的资源，而不是独立的OAuth提供者，这为项目未来发展提供了一个方向。
• **性能问题**：swyx提出了关于使用Cloudflare Workers的潜在性能问题，特别是涉及到中央数据库的调用时的延迟。

这些观点共同构成了对该OAuth实现项目的多角度审视，从安全性、架构合理性到性能问题都有讨论。

data.article_summary: Cursor 1.0发布，主要更新包括：引入BugBot用于代码审查，自动捕捉潜在问题并在PR中留言，支持一键修复；Background Agent功能对所有用户开放，支持远程编码，Jupyter Notebooks中可以直接创建和编辑单元格；新增"Memories"功能，可记住对话中的信息并在未来引用；一键安装MCP和OAuth支持，简化服务器认证；聊天中支持Mermaid图表和Markdown表格可视化；新设置和仪表盘界面，提供使用分析和团队统计信息。

主要讨论点：用户对Cursor及其竞争对手（如VSCode、Claude、Zed等）的评价和对比

不同观点：

data.title: The importance of free software to science
data.author: leephillips
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了自由软件在科学研究中的重要性，强调其在实验重复性、数据分析、文档保存和传播等方面的优势。科学进步依赖于结果的可重复性，而使用自由软件可以确保其他研究人员能够获得源代码并重复实验。文章指出，虽然哲学上推崇开放和可重复性，但科学家更关注实用工具，而自由软件因其"自由"特性常为最佳选择。对于如Julia、Python和R等语言，其解释器和编译器均为自由软件，而C、C++和Fortran等语言则可能依赖商业编译器。此外，科学文档的保存需确保长期可读性，PDF格式因其开放标准成为科学出版的优选，而HTML虽然灵活但不适合精确的科学交流。

The importance of free software to science
[LWN subscriber-only content]
June 4, 2025
This article was contributed by Lee Phillips
Free software plays a critical role in science, both in research and in
disseminating it. Aspects of software freedom are directly relevant to
simulation, analysis, document preparation and preservation, security,
reproducibility, and usability. Free software brings practical and specific
advantages, beyond just its ideological roots, to science, while
proprietary software comes with equally specific risks.  As a practicing
scientist, I would like to help others—scientists or not—see the benefits
from free software in science.
Although there is an implicit philosophical stance here—that
reproducibility and openness in science are desirable, for instance—it is
simply a fact that a working scientist will use the best tools for the job,
even if those might not strictly conform to the laudable goals of the
free-software movement. It turns out that free software, by virtue of its
freedom, is often the best tool for the job.
Reproducing results
Scientific progress depends, at its core, on
reproducibility
. Traditionally, this referred to the results of
experiments: it should be possible to attempt their replication by
following the procedures described in papers. In the case of a failure to
replicate the results, there should be enough information in the paper to
make that
finding meaningful.
LWN.net is able to bring you articles like this one because of our
generous subscribers. If you want to see more like it, consider taking
advantage of our special offer:
1 month trial subscription
The use of computers in science adds some extra dimensions to this
concept. If the conclusions depend on some complex data massaging using a
computer program, another researcher should be able to run the same program
on the original or new data. Simulations should be reproducible by running
the identical simulation code. In both cases this implies access to, and the
right to distribute, the relevant source code. A mere description of the
algorithms used, or a mention of the name of a commercial software product,
is not good enough to satisfy the demands of a meaningful attempt at
replication.
The source code alone is sometimes not enough. Since the details of the
results of a calculation can depend on the compiler, the entire chain from
source to machine code needs to be free to ensure reproducibility. This
condition is automatically met for languages like
Julia
,
Python
, and
R
, whose interpreters and
compilers are free software. For C, C++, and Fortran, the other currently
popular languages for simulation and analysis, this is only sometimes the
case. To get the best performance from Fortran simulations, for example,
scientists often use commercial compilers provided by chip manufacturers.
Document preparation and
preservation
The forward march of science is recorded in papers which are collected on
preprint servers (such as
arXiv
), on the home pages of
scientists, and published in journals. It's obviously bad for science if
future generations can't read these papers, or if a researcher can no
longer open a manuscript after upgrading their word-processing
software. Fortunately, the
future readability of published papers is enabled by the adoption, by
journals and preprint servers, of PDF as the universal standard format for
the distribution of published work. This has been the case even with journals
that request Microsoft Word files for manuscript submission.
PDF files are based on an open, versioned standard and will be readable
into the foreseeable future with all of the formatting details
preserved. This is essential in science, where communication is not merely
through words but depends on figures, captions, typography, tables, and
equations. Outside the world of scientific papers, HTML is by far the
dominant markup language used for online communication. It has advantages
over PDF in that simple documents take less bandwidth, HTML is more easily
machine-readable and human-editable, and by default text flows to fit the
reader's viewport. But this last advantage is an example of why HTML is not
ideal for scientific communication: its flexibility means that documents
can appear differently on different devices.
The final rendering of a web document is the result of interpretation of
HTML and CSS by the browser. The display of mathematics typically depends
on evolving JavaScript libraries, as well, so the author does not know
whether the reader is seeing what was intended. The "P" in PDF stands for
"portable": every reader sees the same thing, on every device, using the

André Truong Trong Thi was born on the 30th of January in 1936 in what is today the Chợ Lớn quarter of Ho Chi Minh City. In early 1950, he moved to France at the age of 14. It’s easy to imagine that he and his family would be eager to leave Vietnam at this time. Ho Chi Minh had declared the independence of North Vietnam in September of 1945, and both the PRC and USSR recognized the DRV as the legitimate government of Vietnam in January of 1950. That war was on the horizon was easy to see. In France, Trong Thi studied at the École française de radioélectricité, graduated, and went to work for Schlumberger. While Schlumberger is now headquartered in Texas and involved in oil, at this time, the company was more involved in logging, surveying, and electrical measurement and mapping; their oil initiatives were just starting. Following his time at Schlumberger, Trong Thi went to work for the new Intertechnique company. Intertechnique specialized in electronics for aviation both on the ground and in the air, but the company’s expertise expanded to include controls and computers for nuclear energy, medicine, and industrial automation. This grew in importance and led to Intertechnique being the first European company to produce a mini-computer, the Multi-8, in 1969. Other than the Multi-8, control systems for Intertechnique’s customers were largely bespoke. Trong Thi saw a future where a standardized, small, affordable system could be made using a more open architecture.
R2E logo as of 1974
In 1970, André Truong Trong Thi and Paul Magneron (director of sales at Intertechnique) founded Réalisation d'Études Électroniques, better known as R2E, in Orsay. In the early days of the company, they focused on electronic systems for use in the medical and nuclear energy fields; fields in which many early members of the company had expertise having worked for Intertechnique. Trong Thi and another employee at Intertechnique had visited the USA, and there they’d learned about the nascent IC industry. More specifically, they’d learned about
Intel
.
In 1972, Alain Perrier of the Institut national de la recherche agronomique, or INRA, needed a computer to assist in the measurement of evapotranspiration (movement of water from vegetation to the air). R2E was in a good position to complete and fulfill this request and thus began the Micral project in June of 1972. Trong Thi delegated the design and implementation to François Gernelle. For his part, Gernelle had left Intertechnique and joined R2E in 1971 specifically to get a chance to work with integrated circuits. The team for the project consisted of about four people including Gernelle, Alain Lacombe, Jean-Claude Beckmann, and a Mr. Benchetrit, and they were moving quite rapidly. In a cellar in the suburbs of Paris, they worked long days and delivered the Micral N in January of 1973.
The Micral N, image from Christie’s, this unit was purchased by Paul Allen
The chassis and Pluribus, image from the Micral manual
The computer was built around the Intel 8008 operating at 500kHz and a 74-pin backplane bus called the Pluribus capable of accepting 11 cards. The Micral N could accommodate two Pluribuses, and when so configured could accept 22 cards. The Pluribus was mounted in a cast aluminum frame, and when assembled the computer measured 17.2 inches wide, 16 inches long, and 5.2 inches tall. The cards measured 8.3 inches long and 4.7 inches tall. Memory was added to the machine via Pluribus cards, and each card could carry 2K. The processor card carried the i8008, interrupt controller, real time clock, system ROM, memory controller, and I/O controller. The manual states that maximum memory was 16K. Early units in 1973 lacked an assembler; the boot ROM and other code was written on a Multi-8 and a cross-assembler was used. The very first Micral N was delivered on the 15th of January in 1973 making the Micral N
the second
microcomputer commercially available.
The Q1 beat it by one month
. The initial price of the Micral N was 8500 francs, torturously working through currency conversions and inflation this would be roughly $10,064 (unless I made a mistake somewhere). Only around 500 units were sold and these were primarily to INRA, Commissariat à l'énergie atomique et aux énergies alternatives (CEA), Crédit Agricole, and motorway toll companies.
The Micral S, image by Damien Boureille
In 1974, R2E released the Micral G. The system design was much the same but the i8008 was clocked at 1MHz and the base RAM was upgraded to 16K. Later that year, the company introduced the Micral S. This was much the same but used an Intel 8080 at 1MHz. These systems were also the first from R2E to include both an in-ROM

data.title: Mistral Code
data.author: tosh
data.article_summary: Mistral Code是一款企业级AI编码助手，提供智能代码补全、生成和自主任务执行功能。它利用先进的人工智能模型，如Codestral和Devstral，能够深度理解代码库，并在开发者工作的IDE中直接运行。其特点包括上下文感知的代码理解、自主编码、实时代码补全、代码编辑和智能搜索等。Mistral Code帮助开发团队提高生产力，支持代码调试、重构、文档生成、测试、迁移和性能优化。该工具可定制并确保代码隐私和安全，适合在重要代码环境中部署，提供一体化平台和快速支持。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Mistral Code Enterprise的产品定位、定价模式及其市场反应

不同观点：
• **对企业销售模式的支持**：一些评论认为，Mistral Code的"联系我们"定价和企业级销售模式是合理的，尤其是针对那些出于安全或其他原因无法使用前沿模型的组织。这类客户通常需要经过企业销售流程、安全审查等，因此这种模式对他们而言并不构成重大障碍（如mwigdahl的观点）。

• **对企业销售模式的批评**：其他评论则批评这种企业级销售模式，认为不让个人开发者试用是错误的策略，尤其是对于一个没有市场记录的新工具来说。这种做法被认为是缺乏透明度，且可能反映出公司管理层的问题（如atonse和joshstrange的观点）。

• **对产品质量和市场竞争力的质疑**：一些评论质疑Mistral模型的质量和市场竞争力，认为如果Mistral拥有领先的模型，他们会提供透明的定价。还有人将Mistral与现有的免费工具（如Aider、Claude Code等）进行比较，质疑其独特价值（如tormeh和joshstrange的观点）。

• **对定价和市场策略的不满**：有评论指出，Mistral不仅要求用户联系销售团队获取定价，还要求提供公司规模和收入等信息，这种做法被认为是不合理的，尤其是对于想要支持欧洲AI公司的欧洲企业来说（如coolgoose的观点）。

补充讨论：
• **产品信息不明确**：一些评论提到Mistral的官网信息不清晰，用户难以找到产品的基本信息，如产品类型和功能描述（如kiratp的观点）。

• **市场需求和时机**：有评论讨论了为何现在突然出现这么多代码助手应用，并猜测这可能与LLM性能的 plateau 有关，市场竞争从模型性能转向应用功能（如abdullahkhalids的观点）。

• **技术实现和替代方案**：一些评论提到了现有的免费替代方案，如使用zed + ollama实现类似的功能，或者使用Aider等工具作为Mistral的后端（如mirekrusin和KolmogorovComp的观点）。

争议焦点：
• **企业销售模式的合理性**：一方认为这种模式适合企业客户，另一方则认为不让个人开发者试用会导致负面市场反应。
• **产品的市场竞争力**：一方质疑Mistral的模型质量和定价策略，另一方则提到市场上已有免费替代方案。

data.title: The Echo in the Machine
data.author: danso
data.article_summary: 《The Echo in the Machine》一文简要介绍了语音转文本技术的发展历程。如今，点击按钮即可实现语音转文本，如YouTube自动生成字幕和手机实时转录，但这一技术的实现曾面临诸多挑战。文章讲述了一群 unlikely 的抗议者和办公室工作人员如何推动这项技术的成功。本集广播由Simon Adler报道和制作，并提供原创音乐和音效设计。听众可通过订阅新闻通讯、成为会员等方式支持Radiolab。该节目还得到了多个基金会的支持。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：人工智能（AI）在闭路字幕领域取代人工速记员的过程及其影响

不同观点：
• [支持AI取代人力的观点]  
  - AI技术在2000年代初期开始试验，逐渐成熟并能够承担越来越多的字幕工作。到2023年，AI已经承担了大约50%的闭路字幕工作，表明其在效率和成本上的优势。
  - 随着AI技术的进步，人工速记员的角色逐渐被削弱，AI最终可能完全取代人类在这个领域的工作。

• [质疑AI取代人力的观点]  
  - 一些顶尖的速记员（如法院速记员）在准确性和应对复杂语言环境方面仍能超越AI。
  - 尽管AI的自动转录技术在大多数情况下已经“足够好”，但其在处理口音、标点符号和自然语言转换等细节方面仍存在不足。

• [对市场影响的观点]  
  - AI的“足够好”的自动转录技术可能在商业上碾压人工服务，类似于工业革命期间机器生产对传统手工制造业的冲击。
  - 人工速记行业可能面临萎缩，因为企业更倾向于选择成本更低的AI技术。

补充讨论：
- 讨论中提到了Plover项目，这是一个与速记相关的开源项目，曾在相关讨论中被多次提及。
- 有人指出速记行业本身的复杂性和专业性，如法院速记员的工作，具有很高的专业门槛，且在AI完全取代之前仍有一定的优势。
- 争议的焦点在于AI是否能够在所有情况下完全取代人工速记员，特别是在处理复杂语言环境和高度准确性要求的情况下。

总结：评论主要讨论了AI在闭路字幕领域取代人工速记员的过程，一方认为AI技术已经足够成熟并将在未来完全取代人类，另一方则认为人工速记员在某些方面仍具优势，但市场趋势可能更倾向于使用成本更低的AI技术。争议点在于AI取代人工的彻底性和速度。

  - 尽管AI的自动转录技术在大多数情况下已经“足够好”，但其在处理口音、标点符号和自然语言转换等细节方面仍存在不足。

• [对市场影响的观点]  
  - AI的“足够好”的自动转录技术可能在商业上碾压人工服务，类似于工业革命期间机器生产对传统手工制造业的冲击。
  - 人工速记行业可能面临萎缩，因为企业更倾向于选择成本更低的AI技术。

补充讨论：
- 讨论中提到了Plover项目，这是一个与速记相关的开源项目，曾在相关讨论中被多次提及。
- 有人指出速记行业本身的复杂性和专业性，如法院速记员的工作，具有很高的专业门槛，且在AI完全取代之前仍有一定的优势。
- 争议的焦点在于AI是否能够在所有情况下完全取代人工速记员，特别是在处理复杂语言环境和高度准确性要求的情况下。

总结：评论主要讨论了AI在闭路字幕领域取代人工速记员的过程，一方认为AI技术已经足够成熟并将在未来完全取代人类，另一方则认为人工速记员在某些方面仍具优势，但市场趋势可能更倾向于使用成本更低的AI技术。争议点在于AI取代人工的彻底性和速度。

data.title: Connecticut legislature overhauls towing laws to reduce 'predatory towing'
data.author: noleary
data.article_summary: 康涅狄格州立法机构通过了一项重大改革拖车法律的提案，旨在保护司机免受掠夺性拖车行为的影响。新法案使从私人财产拖车变得更加困难，并简化了司机在车辆被拖后的取回流程。该法案是对CT Mirror和ProPublica调查报道的回应，报道揭示了现行法律偏向拖车公司的现象，尤其对低收入人群影响严重。新法规定拖车公司必须接受信用卡，且不能仅因过期的停车许可或注册就立即拖车。对于价值1500美元以下的车辆，拖车公司需在销售前采取更多步骤通知车主，并需提供拖车前后的照片以确保透明度。该法案得到了跨党派的广泛支持，预计州长将签署成为法律，于10月1日生效。

Connecticut Legislature Passes Bill Overhauling Century-Old Towing Laws
The reforms, which were proposed in response to an investigation by CT Mirror and ProPublica, make it harder to tow vehicles from private property and easier for drivers to retrieve them after a tow.

The Connecticut Senate on Friday overwhelmingly passed the most significant reform to the state’s towing policies in decades, a measure lawmakers said would help protect drivers from predatory towing.
House Bill 7162
overhauls the state’s century-old towing statutes and comes in response to an investigation by the Connecticut Mirror and ProPublica that showed
how state towing laws have come to favor tow companies
at the expense of drivers. It takes several steps to make it harder to tow vehicles from private property and easier for drivers to retrieve their vehicles after a tow.
The bill, which
passed the House of Representatives
last week with wide bipartisan support and little debate, sailed through the Senate on a 33-3 vote.
“It’s reform that ensures transparency, it ensures fairness and accountability, but does all of this without undercutting the essential work that ethical and professional tow operators do each and every day for us, keeping our roads safe and our properties accessible,” said Transportation Committee Co-chair Sen. Christine Cohen, D-Guilford. “We’ve learned over the years, and particularly over the last year due to some investigative reporting, of some particularly egregious circumstances.”
A spokesperson for Gov. Ned Lamont said the governor plans to sign the bill into law.
Republican Sen. Tony Hwang, ranking member of the Transportation Committee, also spoke in favor of the bill. The bill got about a half hour of debate ahead of passage, and there were no comments in opposition.
Hwang, who represents Fairfield, said the bill strikes the right balance between the interests of towers and consumers.
“I want to acknowledge that our press had an important part to bring out transparency and some of the bad actions, and I think in this bill we address some of those issues,” Hwang said. “We took measures to ensure that there is due process, and what has been discovered to have occurred in a criminal action, I believe, should never, ever happen again, to undermine the trust that we have to have in this process.”
Connecticut’s law allows tow companies to begin the process to sell vehicles after just 15 days. CT Mirror and ProPublica found that it is one of the shortest windows in the nation, and that the law has particularly impacted people with low incomes. Reporters spoke with people who said towing companies required them to pay in cash or wouldn’t allow them to get personal belongings out of their vehicles. Many couldn’t afford to get their towed vehicles back and lost transportation or jobs because of it.
After weeks of negotiations, lawmakers said they came to a compromise with the towing industry. Two bills were merged to include massive reforms to towing procedures from private property and rate increases for highway tows that typically follow car accidents.
The bill that passed and would take effect Oct. 1 requires tow companies to accept credit cards and doesn’t allow them to tow vehicles immediately just because of an expired parking permit or registration. Vehicles can’t be towed from private property without notice unless they’re blocking traffic, fire hydrants or parked in an accessible spot.
Under the bill, towing companies can still start the sales process for vehicles worth $1,500 or less after 15 days, but they would now have to take more steps to give the owner a chance to claim the vehicle. The Department of Motor Vehicles would be required to check whether the driver filed any complaints about the tow before approving the sale, and the tower would have to send a notice ahead of the sale to the registered owner and lienholders via certified mail, with receipts of delivery.
The actual sale couldn’t go through until 30 days after the tow.
The bill also requires that towers take at least two photos before they tow a vehicle — one of the violation that resulted in a tow and another of any damage to the vehicle. Cohen said this would help determine if vehicles had any missing parts before the tow, a seeming nod to the news organiz

data.title: How to Read a Novel
data.author: ingve
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何阅读小说以及小说的价值

不同观点：
• [nilirl] 认为文章标题“如何阅读小说”与实际内容不符。文章大部分内容在讨论小说为何有用，而不是具体如何阅读小说。作者提到的“替代性学习”作为小说的价值，以及通过是否提供可识别的人类决策经验来选择书籍，虽然有道理，但并不是关于“如何阅读”的指导。

• [jihadjihad] 强调了一些经典小说如《米德尔马契》和《荒凉山庄》不仅展示了角色的心理内在，还让读者在不同经验层次上进行思考，并建立因果和联想的联系。他还特别提到《卡拉马佐夫兄弟》在深度和复杂性上的无可比拟。

• [ednite] 支持Steven Johnson的观点，认为19世纪小说能够让读者在多个经验层次上思考，并举例《堂吉诃德》早在17世纪初就具备这种特点。他强调这类小说不仅作为故事重要，还能帮助读者在现代快节奏、信息饱和的世界中保持清醒和清晰思考。

• [daxfohl] 分享了自己对《米德尔马契》的高度评价，并提到自己对《浮士德》的不理解，即便读了两遍，仍觉得只是陈旧的道德故事，猜测可能只有在德语原文中才能体会其价值。

• [crims0n] 强调阅读文学小说的 enriching 作用，推荐不确定从哪本书开始的读者可以通过有声书来入门，并以《洛丽塔》为例，认为Jeremy Irons的朗读能让人爱上Nabokov的 prose。

• [pickledoyster] 对文章中提到的Stripe CEO每年读10本小说的说法持怀疑态度，认为是炫耀自由时间或者快速浏览了一些主要小说，甚至可能是夸大其词。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于什么构成了“如何阅读小说”的实质内容。nilirl认为文章偏题，而其他评论者则在具体讨论小说的价值和个人体验。
• 不同读者对具体小说的评价和体验各异，如daxfohl对《浮士德》的不满与其他读者对经典小说的高度评价形成对比。
• pickledoyster的评论带有讽刺意味，质疑文章中提到的阅读量的真实性和实际意义。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：大学对特朗普政府立场的回应及后果

不同观点：
• 第一个观点认为，哥伦比亚大学对特朗普政府采取妥协态度是错误的。评论者将特朗普比作法西斯，认为与法西斯主义不能妥协。该观点指出，哥伦比亚大学的妥协行为导致了当前的局面，即大学面临更多的批评和压力。

• 第二个观点指出，特朗普在这个问题上的处理是不明智的（misplay）。评论者认为，由于哥伦比亚大学和哈佛大学采取了不同的立场，特朗普的应对方式让大学处于两难境地——无论是否妥协都会受到批评。这反而可能激发更多大学选择反抗而不是顺从。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于大学应如何应对政治压力，特别是来自政府高层的压力。哥伦比亚大学的妥协立场引发了对其原则性和应对策略的质疑。

• 评论中还提到了一种可能的连锁反应：由于不同大学在应对特朗普政府时的不同结果，其他大学可能会更倾向于采取反抗态度，因为顺从并没有带来任何好处，反而招致更多批评。

• 例子包括哥伦比亚大学和哈佛大学在面对特朗普政府时的不同应对方式，这被用来分析特朗普的处理方式及其后果。

Former engineer shares his experience working for DOGE
NPR's Juana Summers talks with Sahil Lavingia, who worked for the Department of Government Efficiency as a software engineer assigned to the Department of Veterans Affairs, about his experience.

Transcript
Sahil Lavignia, former DOGE engineer, says he didn't see the fraud and abuse in government spending that he was expecting.
Sahil Lavignia
hide caption
toggle caption
Sahil Lavignia
A former employee of the Department of Government Efficiency says that he found that the federal waste, fraud and abuse that his agency was supposed to uncover were "relatively nonexistent" during his short time embedded within the Department of Veterans Affairs.
"I personally was pretty surprised, actually, at how efficient the government was," Sahil Lavignia told NPR's Juana Summers.
Lavignia was a successful software developer and the founder of Gumroad, a platform for online sales, when he joined
DOGE
in March. Lavignia said he had previously sought to work for the U.S. Digital Service, the technology unit that was renamed and restructured by the Trump administration. He told NPR that  he just wanted to make government websites easier for citizens to use and didn't really care which presidential administration he was working for, despite protests from his friends and family.
Sponsor Message
Politics
Elon Musk is leaving the federal government. What's next for DOGE?
Lavignia said the overall message at DOGE was transparency and a vibe of "ask for forgiveness, not permission." So, when a blogger asked for an interview about Gumroad, he agreed. And when asked, he talked about his work at DOGE, including how little inefficiency he saw compared to what he was expecting.
"Elon [Musk] was pretty clear about how he wanted DOGE to be maximally transparent," Lavignia said. "That's something he said a lot in private. And publicly. And so I thought, OK, cool, I'll take him at his word. I will be transparent."
Shortly after the interview was published online, Lavignia got an email. Just 55 days into his work at DOGE, his access had been revoked.
This interview has been edited for length and clarity.
Interview highlights:
On why he wanted to work there
It's hard for me to think of a better way to have a larger impact as someone who writes code every day and enjoys, you know, designing and building products, web applications, iPhone applications than working for the U.S. federal government.
Politics
What has DOGE done in Trump's first 100 days?
And Bernie, Hillary, Obama, Trump, it doesn't really matter to me if the work is making it easier to pay taxes or, you know, making it easier for veterans to collect benefits. I like when my software gets used by a lot of people and people send me nice emails. In this case, people weren't sending me the nicest emails, unfortunately. But they also didn't really know what I was doing. They saw DOGE, weren't a fan of certain things that they were associated with. But I think at the end of the day, like, the role of the U.S. Digital Service is to improve the UX (user experience) of being an American, which is pretty exciting. And anyone who lets me do that, I will try to work for, even if my friends and family aren't huge fans.
Sponsor Message
On the lack of fraud and spending abuse he saw
I did not find the federal government to be rife with waste, fraud and abuse. I was expecting some more easy wins. I was hoping for opportunity to cut waste, fraud and abuse. And I do believe that there is a lot of waste. There's minimal amounts of fraud. And abuse, to me, feels relatively nonexistent. And the reason is — I think we have a bias as people coming from the tech industry where we worked at companies, you know, such as Google, Facebook, these companies that have plenty of money, are funded by investors and have lots of people kind of sitting around doing nothing.
Elon Musk shakes hands with President Trump in the Oval Office on Friday. Musk announced he would leave his role in the Trump administration to refocus on his businesses.
Kevin Dietsch/Getty Images

Kevin Dietsch/Getty Images
The government has been under sort of a magnifying glass for decades. And so I think, generally, I personally was pretty surprised, actually, at how efficient the government was. This isn't to say that it can't be made more efficient — elimination of paper, elimination of faxing — but these aren't necessarily fraud, waste and abuse. These are just rooms to modernize and improve the U.S. federal governmen

Reddit is suing Anthropic for allegedly using the site’s data to train AI models without a proper licensing agreement, according to a
complaint
filed in a Northern California court on Wednesday. Reddit claims in the complaint that Anthropic’s unauthorized use of the site’s data for commercial purposes was unlawful, and alleges the AI startup violated Reddit’s user agreement.
Reddit’s lawsuit makes it the first Big Tech company to legally challenge an AI model provider over its training data practices, joining a litany of publishers that have sued tech companies on similar grounds.
The New York Times has sued OpenAI and Microsoft for training on its news articles without payment or permission. Meanwhile, Sarah Silverman and other book authors have
sued Meta for training AI models
on their books without approval. Music publishers and artists have also brought similar claims against AI audio, video, and image generation startups, alleging misuse of their content.
“We will not tolerate profit-seeking entities like Anthropic commercially exploiting Reddit content for billions of dollars without any return for redditors or respect for their privacy,” said Ben Lee, Reddit’s chief legal officer, in a statement to TechCrunch.
Notably, Reddit has inked deals with other AI model providers, including
OpenAI
and
Google
, that allow these companies to train AI models on Reddit’s data and have the site’s posts appear in their respective AI chatbots’ answers. However, in the filing, Reddit says it subjects OpenAI and Google to certain terms that protect its users’ interests and privacy.
Sam Altman, the CEO of OpenAI, has an
8.7% stake in Reddit
, making him the third-largest shareholder, and was once a member of the company’s board of directors.
In the filing, Reddit claims that it approached Anthropic and made it clear that the AI startup did not have authorization to scrape or use Reddit’s content. However, Reddit alleges that Anthropic “refused to engage.”

“We disagree with Reddit’s claims and will defend ourselves vigorously,” said Anthropic spokesperson Danielle Ghighlieri in an emailed statement to TechCrunch.
Reddit claims in its complaint that Anthropic’s scraper bots ignored the social network’s robots.txt files, a standard that signals to automated systems not to crawl websites. The online community platform alleges that, after Anthropic claimed to block its bots from scraping Reddit in 2024, Anthropic’s bots continued to scrape the platform more than 100,000 times.
Reddit is asking Anthropic to pay compensatory damages, as well as restitution for the amount by which Anthropic has been enriched by scraping Reddit’s content. Reddit also requests an injunction prohibiting Anthropic from continuing to use Reddit’s content.

data.article_summary: 美国国税局（IRS）的免费报税软件Direct File可能因特朗普政府而面临取消，但其代码已根据SHARE IT法案在GitHub上开源。虽然该软件依赖于IRS的内部系统无法独立运行，但开源代码为开发新的免费报税工具提供了基础。多位曾参与开发Direct File的人员已加入经济安全项目的未来报税研究基金，继续简化报税流程。与此同时，特朗普政府和Intuit（TurboTax的母公司）等正试图阻止该免费报税工具的发展。

Direct File, the Internal Revenue Service’s long-promised free tax filing software, might be at risk of being killed off by the Trump administration, but the code that made the service possible will live on even if the program itself doesn’t.
According to 404 Media
, the IRS published most of the code for its Direct File on GitHub, making it open source and available for others to use, much to the chagrin of tax lobbyists everywhere.
Before you mistake the move as an act of resistance by those within the agency who are trying to keep the project alive, Direct File getting open-sourced was always part of the plan. The code was published in compliance with the
SHARE IT Act
, which requires agencies to share custom source code (though, of course, the Trump administration is not always motivated by following the law, so this wasn’t a given).
In a
report published last year
, the IRS explained its reasoning for making the code available publicly: “First, it would enable public scrutiny of that code and invite independent groups to assess its accuracy and report potential issues. Second, other tax administrators, both in states and internationally, could build upon and contribute to the IRS’s work, improving the robustness of the software over time and providing additional public value.”
Now that the code is available, it should help others develop functioning (and hopefully free) tax-filing tools. According to 404 Media, the code can’t run independently because it still relies on internal IRS systems; however, it does provide a strong baseline for a platform that is essentially guaranteed to be in compliance with the federal government, as it was built by the government itself.
On a related note, 404 Media pointed out that several of the people who were heavily involved in building Direct File for the IRS have since left the government entirely and joined the Economic Security Project’s Future of Tax Filing Fellowship, where they work on projects designed to make filing taxes simpler and more accessible. It seems like just the type of people who might want to build something based on that open-source codebase.
Direct File getting open-sourced comes at a time when there is a target on the program’s back. The Trump administration, Elon Musk, and tax lobbyists have set out to kill Direct File in one way or another. Musk’s DOGE
blew up 18F
, the government agency that was key to building Direct File, and set out to explicitly
shut down the Direct File tool
despite it being wildly popular among taxpayers. Trump’s Big Beautiful Bill would also
cut the budget entirely for Direct File
, leaving it dead in the water, which would surely thrill Intuit, the company behind TurboTax, that
spent millions of dollars lobbying to kill
a government-provided free tax filing option.

data.article_summary: **Fusarium**是一个包含大量丝状真菌的属，属于**瘤座菌目**，广泛分布于土壤并与植物相关。大多数物种是无害的腐生菌，但有些物种会产生**霉菌毒素**，如**烟镰刀菌**和**禾谷镰刀菌**，这些毒素会影响人类和动物健康。它们产生的主要毒素是**伏马菌素**和**单端孢霉烯**，能导致作物如大麦和小麦的**头枯病**和**根腐病**。其中，**禾谷镰刀菌**对农业影响重大，曾在美国造成约30亿美元的损失。**镰刀菌**还包括一些重要的植物病原体，如导致**香蕉枯萎病**的**尖孢镰刀菌**。该属的分类复杂，存在多种分种方案，且基因组已被测序。

不同观点：

用户girvo表示无法正常访问网站，hCaptcha中的图片（桌子和椅子）一直无法正确显示，即使点击了20多次"Skip"按钮，问题仍未解决。这表明验证机制存在技术故障或设计不合理，影响了用户的正常访问。

部分用户认为，虽然hCaptcha可能在使用中存在一些问题，但它是必要的安全措施，可以防止自动化程序攻击和垃圾信息。例如，验证机制有助于保护网站免受恶意流量的侵害，尽管在用户体验上可能有所牺牲。

• [观点三：特定浏览器的兼容性问题]  
有用户指出，hCaptcha在某些浏览器（如Brave浏览器）上可能存在兼容性问题，导致图片加载失败或无法正常显示。这表明问题可能与具体浏览器的设置或配置有关，而非hCaptcha本身的功能问题。

有用户提到，广告拦截器可能会干扰hCaptcha的正常运行，导致验证图片无法显示。关闭广告拦截器后，部分用户能够正常加载和通过验证。这表明第三方插件可能对网站功能产生影响。

一些用户建议，遇到hCaptcha问题时，可以尝试清除浏览器缓存、禁用广告拦截器或更换浏览器。这些措施可能有助于解决验证机制无法正常工作的问题。

争议的焦点在于如何在确保网站安全的同时，不牺牲用户的访问体验。部分用户认为安全措施至关重要，而另一部分用户则认为过于严格的验证机制会影响正常使用。这反映了安全性和用户体验之间的平衡问题。

总结：用户们对hCaptcha验证机制的可用性和必要性存在不同看法，部分用户遇到技术问题无法正常访问网站，而其他用户则理解其作为安全措施的重要性。技术兼容性和广告拦截器等因素也被认为是影响验证机制正常工作的可能原因。

data.title: After court order, OpenAI is now preserving all ChatGPT user logs
data.author: ColinWright
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：OpenAI 因法院命令需保留所有输出日志数据，引发的隐私、法律和商业影响讨论。

不同观点：
• **[lxgr]**: 指出欧洲法院和政府不会乐见其法律和意见被无视，尤其是隐私法规被加引号处理。这意味着OpenAI可能违反了多项隐私法规。
• **[efskap]**: 强调这一命令不仅影响ChatGPT用户，还影响使用OpenAI API的用户，包括免费版、Plus版和Pro版的用户，可能对OpenAI的业务造成负面影响。
• **[paxys]**: 提出OpenAI不仅需要保留这些数据，还可能被要求在法律诉讼中分享数据，这可能导致用户隐私泄露，甚至在法庭上公开私人对话。
• **[celnardur]**: 认为LLM（大语言模型）的隐私问题一直是其致命弱点，特别是在处理敏感工作数据时，如代码和受监管数据，无法信任云端工具，直到这些工具可以本地化运行。
• **[ronsor]**: 强调法院命令可能违反多个司法管辖区的隐私法和OpenAI与客户的现有合同。
• **[solfox]**: 指出其他AI系统（如Google Gemini、Grok等）也可能面临类似命令，建议使用替代工具避免隐私问题。
• **[Imnimo]**: 质疑OpenAI是否会通知用户其数据保留政策的变化，还是让企业通过媒体得知，这可能影响企业的信任和使用决策。
• **[DevX101]**: 提到一些企业因不信任OpenAI的数据处理方式而选择自托管LLM模型，这一事件证明了他们的决定是正确的。

补充讨论：
• **链接和访问问题**: 多个评论者提供了相关文章链接，并讨论了由于流量过大导致链接无法访问的问题，部分用户通过存档网站（如Wayback Machine）访问内容。
• **法律和隐私责任**: 一些用户（如[jwpapi]）对现有API使用的法律和隐私责任表示困惑，特别是当通过API密钥使用OpenAI服务时，责任归属问题。
• **数据所有权和透明度**: [MeIam] 质疑《纽约时报》等实体是否有权查看用户数据，反映了对数据所有权和透明度的担忧。

争议焦点：
• 法院命令与隐私法规的冲突：OpenAI是否应该遵守法院命令，即使这可能违反隐私法和用户协议。
• 数据保留和用户隐私：OpenAI保留所有日志数据是否会严重影响用户隐私，尤其是在法律诉讼中可能被要求披露这些数据。
• 对业务的影响：这一命令对OpenAI及其客户，特别是依赖API的企业用户，可能带来的商业和法律风险。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：特斯拉自动驾驶（FSD）技术的安全性及相关数据的可获取性

不同观点：
• duxup认为，除非有非常充分的理由，否则由纳税人资助的国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）所拥有的数据，纳税人应有权访问。该观点强调了数据透明度和公众知情权。

• mosdl分享了一个涉及特斯拉自动驾驶功能的交通事故，并指出初步报告显示特斯拉处于自动驾驶模式。该评论暗示了对特斯拉不利的可能性，但没有确定责任归属。

• nemothekid则为特斯拉辩护，指出许多声称“FSD导致事故”的案例实际上是用户不负责任地驾驶，然后将责任推给自动驾驶功能。该评论强调了用户误用技术的问题。

• Havoc以讽刺的语气表示，特斯拉尚未成功掩盖所有负面事件，暗示对特斯拉处理事故信息的方式持怀疑态度。

• jfoster提到《华盛顿邮报》对特斯拉的报道，指出该报的所有者与自动驾驶技术公司Zoox有关联，暗示可能存在利益冲突。

• JumpCrisscross表达了对某些地区可能加强自动驾驶汽车审批标准的期望，甚至建议暂时禁止仅依赖摄像头的自动驾驶汽车上路。

• 7e强调公共道路上的数据应为公共数据，认为公众有权了解特斯拉自动驾驶技术带来的风险。

• FireBeyond引用路透社的报道，指出特斯拉的先进驾驶辅助系统（如Autopilot和FSD）广为人知，暗示媒体对特斯拉技术的关注。

• MaxPock以讽刺语气质疑马斯克是否会隐藏信息，暗示对特斯拉透明度的怀疑。

• alfor直接指责路透社为宣传工具，认为其报道可能受到信息战影响，暗示对媒体信息的不信任。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于特斯拉自动驾驶技术的安全性和事故数据的透明度。
• 讨论中涉及媒体的角色及其可能的利益冲突，以及公众对自动驾驶技术风险的知情权。
• 对特斯拉技术误用的批评与对其透明度的质疑形成了讨论的两大方向。

data.title: Not All Tokens Are Meant to Be Forgotten
data.author: MarcoDewey
data.article_summary: 文章提出了一种针对性信息遗忘（TIF）框架，以解决大型语言模型（LLM）在遗忘不必要信息时的“过度遗忘”问题。TIF框架通过识别遗忘样本中的 unwanted words (UW) 和 general words (GW)，利用逻辑偏好损失函数来遗忘UW相关信息，同时通过保留损失函数保护GW中的有用信息，从而提高遗忘效果并减少模型效用损失。实验表明，TIF在TOFU和MUSE基准上取得了显著效果，有效提升了遗忘效率并保持了模型实用性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI在处理和遗忘信息方面的能力及其与人类的对比

不同观点：
• pixl97认为，AI会记忆不必要的信息，如私人或受版权保护的内容，而这可能带来问题。他们指出，人类不会真正忘记受版权保护的信息，通常只是对其进行调整以避免侵权。同时，人类可能不会分享私人信息，但这些信息仍然会影响我们的思维。

• pixl97对一个由AI主导的世界表示担忧，在这个世界中，AI被设计成遗忘大量信息，而这些信息是人类每天需要处理的。这种设想被认为是有害且带有反乌托邦色彩的。

补充讨论：
• pixl97强调了AI在处理私人或敏感信息时的潜在风险，特别是当这些信息被AI记忆并可能无意中使用或分享时。
• 对于受版权保护的信息，pixl97提到人类通过调整信息来避免法律问题，而AI可能不具备这种能力，从而可能导致版权纠纷。
• 最后，pixl97对AI被编程为遗忘大量信息的概念表示忧虑，认为这可能导致一个令人不安的未来。

争议焦点：
• AI在处理私人或版权信息时是否应该具备类似于人类的“遗忘”能力，或者是否应该有其他机制来管理这些信息。
• 一个依赖AI遗忘大量信息的社会是否可取，以及这种做法可能带来的潜在风险和伦理问题。

View a PDF of the paper titled Not All Tokens Are Meant to Be Forgotten, by Xiangyu Zhou and 5 other authors
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
Large Language Models (LLMs), pre-trained on massive text corpora, exhibit remarkable human-level language understanding, reasoning, and decision-making abilities. However, they tend to memorize unwanted information, such as private or copyrighted content, raising significant privacy and legal concerns. Unlearning has emerged as a promising solution, but existing methods face a significant challenge of over-forgetting. This issue arises because they indiscriminately suppress the generation of all the tokens in forget samples, leading to a substantial loss of model utility. To overcome this challenge, we introduce the Targeted Information Forgetting (TIF) framework, which consists of (1) a flexible targeted information identifier designed to differentiate between unwanted words (UW) and general words (GW) in the forget samples, and (2) a novel Targeted Preference Optimization approach that leverages Logit Preference Loss to unlearn unwanted information associated with UW and Preservation Loss to retain general information in GW, effectively improving the unlearning process while mitigating utility degradation. Extensive experiments on the TOFU and MUSE benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed TIF framework enhances unlearning effectiveness while preserving model utility and achieving state-of-the-art results.

data.title: Ada and SPARK enter the automotive ISO-26262 market with Nvidia
data.author: gneuromante
data.article_summary: AdaCore和NVIDIA合作，将Ada和SPARK编程语言引入汽车市场，并发布了一个开源的参考流程，帮助其他企业采用这些语言。NVIDIA的Drive® OS专为自动驾驶车辆开发，其中的关键软件组件符合ISO-26262汽车安全标准，利用了Ada和SPARK的形式化方法和安全特性。该参考流程文档可免费使用和定制，旨在帮助行业提升软件安全性。AdaCore强调，随着汽车行业向软件功能转型，软件安全成为关键挑战，而NVIDIA通过引入Ada和SPARK展示了技术领导力。参考流程可在相关网站获取。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Ada/SPARK与C语言在安全性、可靠性方面的比较及其在Nvidia等高安全性领域中的应用

不同观点：
• **支持Ada/SPARK的观点**：评论中有人认为Ada/SPARK在安全性、可靠性方面具有优势，适合用于对安全性要求高的领域，如军事、航空航天等。Ada语言的设计初衷即是为了提高系统的安全性和可靠性，特别是在关键任务系统中。SPARK作为Ada的子集，进一步增强了形式验证能力，减少了代码中的潜在错误。因此，在涉及高安全性需求的场景下，Ada/SPARK可能比C更适合。

• **质疑Ada/SPARK的观点**：FirmwareBurner指出，即使是高度重视安全的美国军方也在F-35项目中放弃了Ada，转而使用C++。这引发了对Ada/SPARK是否真的在现代系统中具备竞争力的质疑。有人认为，C和C++在性能、开发者社区、工具链支持等方面有明显的优势，这使得它们在高性能计算（如Nvidia GPU）和一些高安全性需求的场景中依然占据主导地位。

• **关于C语言的安全性问题**：Nvidia Security Team提出了一种极端观点，即“如果完全停止使用C语言会怎样？”。这反映了一些安全专家对C语言内在安全问题的担忧，尤其是内存管理方面的漏洞（如缓冲区溢出）可能导致严重的安全隐患。然而，这一观点也引发了争议，因为C语言在底层系统编程和硬件交互方面具有不可替代的优势。

补充讨论：
• **市场与商业因素**：有人提到Nvidia的高利润率（50%）和市场估值（3万亿美元），质疑是否应在高利润行业中更加重视安全性，即便这意味着放弃一些传统技术（如C语言）。

• **开发者生态与技术迁移成本**：讨论中提到的一个重要问题是开发者对C/C++的熟悉程度以及现有的大量C/C++代码库。迁移到Ada/SPARK可能带来巨大的学习成本和兼容性问题，这也是一些公司不愿轻易放弃C/C++的原因。

• **争议焦点**：Ada/SPARK是否真的适合现代高性能计算领域，尤其是在C/C++已经占据主导地位的情况下。一方认为Ada/SPARK在高安全性系统中具备明显优势，另一方则质疑其实际应用的可行性和迁移成本。

44184861.article_content:
High-integrity software tooling experts,
AdaCore
, are delighted to announce the introduction of the Ada and SPARK programming languages into the automotive market. Together with their partner NVIDIA, they are set to publish an off-the-shelf reference process, allowing others to follow their lead.
NVIDIA developed Drive® OS, the reference operating system and associated software stack designed specifically for developing and deploying autonomous vehicle applications on DRIVE AGX-based hardware.
This system includes software components that comply with the highest levels of integrity of the automotive certification standard ISO-26262. To achieve that effort, NVIDIA selected these languages to develop some of the most critical components of its software stack. This required establishing a development process that takes advantage of formal methods and other safety characteristics of Ada and SPARK, thus fully leveraging their capabilities.
AdaCore and NVIDIA have decided to publish this reference process freely as an open-source and evolving document, allowing the industry at large to adopt Ada and SPARK.
“As the added value of the automotive industry turns more and more from mechanical to software features, achieving software safety at the highest levels becomes one of the most critical challenges of modern car development,
” says Quentin Ochem, Chief Product and Revenue Officer at AdaCore.
“NVIDIA demonstrates truly remarkable technical leadership in the domain by introducing Ada and SPARK into its development process and allowing the rest of the community to follow its path.”
The ISO-26262 reference process is available on
https://nvidia.github.io/spark-process/
or
https://github.com/NVIDIA/spark-process
and can be used or customized freely by anyone interested in adopting these languages.
44184861.article_summary: AdaCore和NVIDIA合作，将Ada和SPARK编程语言引入汽车市场，并发布了一个开源的参考流程，帮助其他企业采用这些语言。NVIDIA的Drive® OS专为自动驾驶车辆开发，其中的关键软件组件符合ISO-26262汽车安全标准，利用了Ada和SPARK的形式化方法和安全特性。该参考流程文档可免费使用和定制，旨在帮助行业提升软件安全性。AdaCore强调，随着汽车行业向软件功能转型，软件安全成为关键挑战，而NVIDIA通过引入Ada和SPARK展示了技术领导力。参考流程可在相关网站获取。
44184861.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Ada/SPARK与C语言在安全性、可靠性方面的比较及其在Nvidia等高安全性领域中的应用

不同观点：
• **支持Ada/SPARK的观点**：评论中有人认为Ada/SPARK在安全性、可靠性方面具有优势，适合用于对安全性要求高的领域，如军事、航空航天等。Ada语言的设计初衷即是为了提高系统的安全性和可靠性，特别是在关键任务系统中。SPARK作为Ada的子集，进一步增强了形式验证能力，减少了代码中的潜在错误。因此，在涉及高安全性需求的场景下，Ada/SPARK可能比C更适合。

• **质疑Ada/SPARK的观点**：FirmwareBurner指出，即使是高度重视安全的美国军方也在F-35项目中放弃了Ada，转而使用C++。这引发了对Ada/SPARK是否真的在现代系统中具备竞争力的质疑。有人认为，C和C++在性能、开发者社区、工具链支持等方面有明显的优势，这使得它们在高性能计算（如Nvidia GPU）和一些高安全性需求的场景中依然占据主导地位。

• **关于C语言的安全性问题**：Nvidia Security Team提出了一种极端观点，即“如果完全停止使用C语言会怎样？”。这反映了一些安全专家对C语言内在安全问题的担忧，尤其是内存管理方面的漏洞（如缓冲区溢出）可能导致严重的安全隐患。然而，这一观点也引发了争议，因为C语言在底层系统编程和硬件交互方面具有不可替代的优势。

补充讨论：
• **市场与商业因素**：有人提到Nvidia的高利润率（50%）和市场估值（3万亿美元），质疑是否应在高利润行业中更加重视安全性，即便这意味着放弃一些传统技术（如C语言）。

• **开发者生态与技术迁移成本**：讨论中提到的一个重要问题是开发者对C/C++的熟悉程度以及现有的大量C/C++代码库。迁移到Ada/SPARK可能带来巨大的学习成本和兼容性问题，这也是一些公司不愿轻易放弃C/C++的原因。

• **争议焦点**：Ada/SPARK是否真的适合现代高性能计算领域，尤其是在C/C++已经占据主导地位的情况下。一方认为Ada/SPARK在高安全性系统中具备明显优势，另一方则质疑其实际应用的可行性和迁移成本。

data.article_summary: VectorSmuggle是一个展示先进数据隐写和隐蔽数据泄露技术的安全研究项目，专注于通过向量表示隐藏敏感信息，规避传统安全控制。该项目模拟利用RAG（Retrieval-Augmented Generation）系统的漏洞，通过语义混淆和行为伪装躲避检测。它支持15种以上文档格式，具备多格式加载、规避能力和增强的查询引擎，提供全面的取证和风险评估工具。项目使用容器化和Kubernetes部署，包含详细的文档和使用指南，旨在帮助安全专业人员理解和防御AI/ML系统中的新型攻击手段。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：通过隐蔽方法（如DNS查询和RAG系统）进行数据渗出的技术及其有效性和实际应用

不同观点：
• [anonymousiam] 认为多年前就存在通过DNS查询绕过防火墙的隐蔽数据渗出方法。具体做法是将base64编码的 payload 作为主机名前缀附加到恶意域名上，并通过时间戳保证唯一性，以绕过本地缓存DNS服务器。该评论强调了这种技术的实际可行性，并给出了具体例子。

• [acmiyaguchi] 对通过隐写术渗出数据的思路表示感兴趣，但质疑所描述方法的实际操作性。他们认为文档和代码不够清晰，威胁模型和案例研究显得人为设计，缺乏实际意义。该评论指出该项目缺乏简洁的技术总结和演示，导致其实用性存疑。

• [smugglereal] 支持该项目，认为它提供了一个全面的概念验证，展示了在AI/ML环境中基于向量的复杂数据渗出技术。该评论强调该项目具有教育意义，并提供了用于防御性分析的工具，特别是在RAG系统中的潜在风险。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于该方法的实际可行性和应用场景。 [acmiyaguchi] 认为这些技术在实际环境中不太可能被广泛使用，而 [smugglereal] 则认为该项目具有重要的教育和防御价值。

• [acmiyaguchi] 强调了文档和代码的不足，指出了项目在传播和应用上的挑战。

VectorSmuggle
"The smuggle is real!"
A comprehensive proof-of-concept demonstrating sophisticated vector-based data exfiltration techniques in AI/ML environments. This educational security research project illustrates potential risks in RAG systems and provides tools for defensive analysis.

data.title: A Look Back at Recent Car Carrier Fires
data.author: testrun
data.article_summary:
2025年6月3日，汽车运输船*Morning Midas*在阿拉斯加阿达克以南300英里处起火，船上22名船员被附近船只*Cosco Hellas*救起，无人受伤。该船载有3,159辆汽车，其中包括电动汽车和混合动力汽车，火灾始于存放电动汽车的甲板。此次事件是近年来汽车运输船火灾频发的一部分，凸显了航运业在运输车辆，尤其是锂电池汽车时面临的挑战。

类似事件还包括：

1. **Fremantle Highway**（2023年7月25日）：日本汽车运输船在荷兰附近起火，23名船员中1人死亡。火灾原因仍在调查。
   
2. **Grande Costa D’Avorio**（2023年7月5日）：意大利滚装船在美国新泽西州纽瓦克港起火，两名消防员殉职，火灾因一辆改装车过热引发。

3. **Felicity Ace**（2022年2月16日）：巴拿马籍船在亚速尔群岛附近起火，载有电动汽车和豪华品牌车辆，最终沉没。

这些事件揭示了汽车运输中的安全隐患，特别是涉及电动汽车时的消防挑战。

A Coast Guard C-130J Super Hercules aircrew from Air Station Kodiak conducts an overflight of a fire aboard the cargo vessel Morning Midas approximately 300 miles south of Adak, Alaska, June 3, 2025.  All 22 crew members were rescued by the crew of motor vessel Cosco Hellas with no reported injuries. (U.S. Coast Guard photo courtesy of Roland Hobson)
A Look Back at Recent Car Carrier Fires
Mike Schuler
Total Views: 17213
June 4, 2025
The fire aboard the car carrier
Morning Midas
in the North Pacific Ocean marks the latest significant incident in the maritime industry’s ongoing challenges involving fires on vehicle carriers. The UK-owned, Liberia-flagged vessel
caught fire
on Tuesday, June 3, 2025, about 300 miles south of Adak, forcing all 22 crew members to evacuate.
The vessel was carrying 3,159 vehicles—including 65 fully electric and 681 partial hybrid electric vehicles—when crew members spotted smoke coming from a deck containing electric vehicles. Despite immediately activating onboard fire suppression systems, the crew couldn’t contain the fire and had to abandon ship via life raft. They were safely transferred to a nearby good Samaritan vessel.
The Morning Midas had departed Yantai, China on May 26 and was heading to Lázaro Cárdenas, Mexico, with an expected arrival of June 15. The Coast Guard is now working with the vessel’s management company, London-based Zodiac Maritime, on salvage operations and next steps.
This incident follows a concerning pattern of similar events in recent years, underscoring the shipping industry’s challenges with vehicle transport, especially those equipped with lithium-ion batteries. Each incident in this growing list of car carrier fires provides crucial safety insights. Previous examples are detailed below:
Fremantle Highway
The Fremantle Highway on fire in the North Sea, July 26, 2023. Photo courtesy Netherlands Coastguard
The
Fremantle Highway
, a Japanese-owned car carrier with 3,783 vehicles aboard, caught fire on July 25, 2023, near Ameland, Netherlands. The crew was unable to extinguish the fire, leading to its evacuation. Of 23 Indian crew members, 16 were rescued by helicopter, seven jumped overboard, and one died.
The fire eventually burned out and the vessel was towed to Eemshaven, where 1,000 vehicles were salvaged from lower decks. The damaged ship was later sent to China for repairs. Despite proximity to the Wadden Sea UNESCO site and risk from fuel oil, no major environmental damage occurred.
The fire’s cause remains under investigation by Panama Maritime Authority with Dutch assistance. Early EV-related theories were dismissed as EVs were stored in unaffected areas.
A recent investigation by the Dutch Safety Board found
major flaws
in the response to the incident, citing poor prioritization of crew rescue and communication issues that delayed medical treatment.
Grande Costa D’Avorio
he motor vessel Grande Costa D’Avorio is shown from an unmanned aircraft systems perspective of fire fighting efforts from a Unified Command in attempts to extinguish the fire aboard the ship at Port Newark, New Jersey, July 8, 2023. U.S. Coast Guard image from video
The Italian-flagged
Grande Costa D’Avorio
, a combination roll-on/roll-off (ConRo) ship caught fire on July 5, 2023, while loading used vehicles for export at Port Newark, New Jersey. Tragically, two firefighters were killed in the initial response and six others were injured. The fire continued to burn for about six days before it was extinguished.
At the time of the fire, the the ship was carrying around 1,200 vehicles and 157 containers, but no electric vehicles or hazardous cargo was on board.
The NTSB’s investigation
revealed
that the fire started when a modified passenger vehicle used for loading overheated. Using this vehicle violated OSHA standards for industrial equipment. A faulty garage door design prevented crew from sealing the fire zone, making the CO2 suppression system useless.
Poor marine firefighting preparedness led to critical mistakes. Firefighters entered CO2-activated areas against protocols, and lacking proper vessel firefighting training, two firefighters were lost after becoming disoriented in the smoke.
Felicity Ace
Felicity Ace
seen burning in the Atlantic Ocean off the Azores Islands. Picture was released Friday, February 18, 2022 by the Portuguese Navy. Photo courtesy Portuguese Navy
The Panama-flagged
Felicity Ace
, operated by Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (MOL), caught fire on February 16, 2022, approximately 90 nautical miles southwest of the Azores as the ship was underway from Embden, Germany to the U.S. East Coast. All 22 crew members abandoned ship safely.
The ship was reportedly carrying some 4,000 vehicles, including some electric vehicles and luxury brands like Porsches, Bentleys, and Lamborghinis, along with VW and Audis. The fire continued to burned until the ship sank about two weeks later on March 1, 2022. The Panama Maritime Authority’s investigation report into the incident wa

• 观点三：有用户指出，延迟可能与系统负载有关。在高并发情况下，系统可能无法及时响应所有请求，导致延迟。这部分用户更倾向于理解技术限制，但仍然希望问题得到解决。

补充讨论：
• 部分用户建议通过优化系统架构、增加服务器资源或采用缓存机制来减少延迟。
• 争议的焦点在于责任归属问题，一些用户认为服务提供方应完全负责解决延迟问题，而另一些用户则认为用户自身也应注意自身设备和网络环境的影响。
• 还有用户提到，延迟是否对整体服务体验造成了实质性影响，一些人认为偶尔的延迟可以接受，只要不影响最终结果。

data.author: ohjeez
data.article_summary: 这篇文章回顾了1978年科幻作家亚瑟·克拉克（Arthur C. Clarke）在纪录片《Mind Machines》中对人工智能（AI）发展的预测。克拉克认为，人类正在创造“继任者”——人工智能，未来可能出现比人类更智能的系统，这将彻底改变社会。他提出，AI的崛起将迫使人类思考存在的意义和生活目的。尽管当时AI技术仍处于初级阶段，如计算机国际象棋比赛和模拟治疗师，但克拉克的预言引发了对未来人机关系的深刻思考。文章还提到，AI发展经历了多次繁荣与萧条周期，每次技术无法达到预期时就会进入“AI寒冬”。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：科幻作品中对人工智能（AI）及大型语言模型（LLMs）的预测和描述

不同观点：
• [dhosek] 提到在80年代初读过的一个短篇故事，该故事预测了LLMs的概念。故事中的系统通过一只连接到计算机的猩猩来实现AI功能，用户可以输入文本开头，系统会生成理想的结尾。这表明早期科幻作品中已经对AI生成内容有所想象。

• [detourdog] 提到了1905年的一篇名为《The Machine Stops》的短篇小说，认为这篇作品也预见了AI的发展，强调了早期科幻作品对未来科技的洞察力。

• [timmg] 提到Heinlein的小说《The Moon is a Harsh Mistress》，认为这本书与当前AI和LLMs的发展有特别的相关性，强调了科幻作品中对AI的描绘和现实科技发展的联系。

• [ednite] 指出《星际迷航》在1967年的一集中已经描绘了反叛AI的角色Nomad，比HAL 9000早了一年，并分析了这种AI形象可能源于战后焦虑及历史事件的影响。同时，ednite赞扬了Asimov在1940年代提出的机器人三定律，认为这是对伦理AI的重要贡献。

• [tokamak] 简单提到Stenislaw Lem在1957年的作品《Dialogues》，进一步补充了在不同年代和不同作者对AI的描绘。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中提到的多个作品展示了AI在不同年代科幻作品中的多样化形象，包括通过动物辅助实现AI功能、AI反叛、以及伦理AI的构想。
• 争议的焦点可能在于哪部作品最早或最准确地预测了AI的发展，以及不同作品中AI形象的文化和社会背景。
• 评论中提到的多个作品展现了科幻作家对未来科技的深刻洞察，以及这些作品与当前科技发展的相关性。

总结来看，这些评论展示了不同读者对各个年代科幻作品中AI描绘的回顾和分析，强调了这些作品在预测和启发当前AI技术发展中的重要作用。

Sci-Fi Writer Arthur C. Clarke Predicted the Rise of Artificial Intelligence & the Existential Questions We Would Need to Answer (1978)
in
History
,
Technology
,
Television
|   	December 9th, 2024
Leave a Comment
We now live in the midst of an arti­fi­cial-intel­li­gence boom, but it’s hard­ly the first of its kind. In fact, the field has been sub­ject to a boom-and-bust cycle since at least the ear­ly nine­teen-fifties. Even­tu­al­ly, those busts — which occurred when real­iz­able AI tech­nol­o­gy failed to live up to the hype of the boom — became so long and so thor­ough­go­ing that each was declared an “AI win­ter” of scant research fund­ing and pub­lic inter­est. Yet even deep into one such fal­low sea­son, AI could still inspire enough fas­ci­na­tion to become the sub­ject of the 1978
NOVA
doc­u­men­tary
“Mind Machines.”
The pro­gram includes inter­views with fig­ures now rec­og­nized as lumi­nar­ies in the his­to­ry of AI:
John McCarthy
,
Mar­vin Min­sky
,
Ter­ry Wino­grad
,
ELIZA
cre­ator
Joseph Weizen­baum
. It also brings on no less a tech­no­log­i­cal prophet than
Arthur C. Clarke
, who notes that the dubi­ous atti­tudes toward the prospect of think­ing machines expressed in the late sev­en­ties had much in com­mon with those about the prospect of space trav­el dur­ing his youth in the thir­ties. In his view, we were already “cre­at­ing our suc­ces­sors. We have seen the first, crude begin­nings of arti­fi­cial intel­li­gence,” and we would “one day be able to design sys­tems that can go on improv­ing them­selves.”
If com­put­ers were there­by to gain greater-than-human intel­li­gence, it would, of course, “com­plete­ly restruc­ture soci­ety” — not that the soci­ety he already knew would­n’t “col­lapse instant­ly” if its own rel­a­tive­ly sim­ple com­put­ers were tak­en away. Clarke not only asks the ques­tion now on many minds of what “the peo­ple who are only capa­ble of low-grade com­put­er-type work” will do when out­stripped by AI, but more deeply under­ly­ing ones as well: “What is the pur­pose of life? What do we want to live for? That is a ques­tion which the intel­li­gent com­put­er will force us to pay atten­tion to.”
Few view­ers in 1978 would have spent much time pon­der­ing such mat­ters before. But pre­sent­ed with footage of all this now-prim­i­tive pro­to-AI tech­nol­o­gy — the com­put­er chess tour­na­ment, the sim­u­lat­ed ther­a­pist, the med­ical-diag­no­sis assis­tant, the NASA Mars rover to be launched in the far-flung future of 1986 — they must at least have felt able to enter­tain the idea that they would live to see an age of machines that could not just think but, as the nar­ra­tor puts it, pos­sess “the most cru­cial aspect of com­mon-sense intel­li­gence: the abil­i­ty to learn.” Per­haps anoth­er AI win­ter will fore­stall that age yet again — if it’s not already here.
